disclaimer: Wellness & Educational Forecasting Only — Not Medical Advice: This tool estimates behavioral fatigue patterns from self-logged habits and does not diagnose sleep disorders or medical conditions. Consult a qualified healthcare professional for persistent insomnia or exhaustion.

alerts.title: Severe Social Jetlag & Circadian Whiplash
alerts.detail: Weekday sleep averages 4.5 h (a 17.5 h weekday deficit) and weekends rebound to 11.5 h. Sleep varies by 3.2 h (SD), so a 7-day average of 6.5 h hides the strain.

alerts.title: Suppressed Deep/REM Sleep Architecture
alerts.detail: Caffeine has a ~5 h half-life: about 128 mg is still active at bedtime on average, and 9 h of daily screen time delays melatonin. Deep (slow-wave) and REM sleep are reduced even when the clock total looks near 6.5 h.

alerts.title: High Cumulative Sleep Debt
alerts.detail: 14.0 h of unrepaid sleep debt against a 8.0 h baseline.

trajectory.label: Escalating
trajectory.note: Debt grew over the second half of the log. Unchanged habits point to a higher score next week.

formulas.name: 7-Day Sleep Debt
formulas.formula: gap = baseline − sleep. If gap > 0: debt += gap. Otherwise: debt = max(0, debt + 0.5 × gap). Surplus sleep repays only half as fast as a deficit builds. Start at debt = 0.

formulas.name: Caffeine Half-Life Residual
formulas.formula: residual = caffeine_mg × 0.5^(hours from last caffeine to bedtime ÷ 5). Upper-bound estimate: the whole day's caffeine is treated as taken at the last-caffeine time.

formulas.name: Circadian Midpoint Variance
formulas.formula: midpoint = bedtime + ((wake − bedtime) mod 24) ÷ 2. Midpoints are averaged on the 24 h circle; variance = RMS of each midpoint's circular deviation from that mean.

formulas.name: Architecture Efficiency
formulas.formula: 100 − min(30, 0.2 × mean residual) − min(15, 1.5 × max(0, mean screen − 4)) − min(15, 5 × midpoint SD) − min(20, 3 × max(0, baseline − mean sleep)), floor 20.

formulas.name: Weighted Burnout Composite Score
formulas.formula: 0.35·DebtScore + 0.15·CaffeineScore + 0.15·ScreenScore + 0.20·InconsistencyScore + 0.15·ArchitectureScore, then raised to the highest guardrail floor if one applies. DebtScore = min(100, debt ÷ 14 × 100); CaffeineScore = ½·min(100, max(0, mean caffeine ÷ limit − 0.5) × 100) + ½·min(100, mean residual ÷ reference × 100); ScreenScore = min(100, max(0, mean screen − 4) ÷ 8 × 100); InconsistencyScore = min(100, 0.6·(midpoint SD ÷ 2.5) × 100 + 0.4·(sleep SD ÷ 3) × 100); ArchitectureScore = min(100, (100 − efficiency) ÷ 50 × 100).

coach.headline: Critical burnout risk – urgent recovery needed
coach.outlook: If you keep the same pattern, sleep debt will keep rising and the burnout score could exceed 95 in the next week. Weekday sleep will stay around 4.5 h, weekends will only mask the deficit. Caffeine and screen exposure will continue to disrupt deep sleep and circadian stability.

bottlenecks.title: Severe sleep debt
bottlenecks.detail: You have accumulated 14 h of unpaid sleep debt; weekday average is 4.5 h versus the 8 h target.

bottlenecks.title: High caffeine residual at night
bottlenecks.detail: Around 128 mg of caffeine remains in your system at bedtime, far above the safe residual (<30 mg).

bottlenecks.title: Excessive screen time
bottlenecks.detail: You average 9 h of screens daily, pushing melatonin release later.

bottlenecks.title: Social jet‑lag
bottlenecks.detail: Weekday‑weekend sleep timing swings by 5 h, creating a 4‑hour circadian mismatch.

schedule.title: Wake up
schedule.detail: Get out of bed, stretch lightly.

schedule.title: Morning light exposure
schedule.detail: Spend 10‑15 min outside or by a bright window.

schedule.title: Hydration & light snack
schedule.detail: Drink water, eat a small protein‑rich snack.

schedule.title: First caffeine dose
schedule.detail: Take a modest 100 mg coffee (stay under 200 mg total).

schedule.title: Deep‑work block
schedule.detail: Focus on priority study tasks, no screens except needed tools.

schedule.title: Movement break
schedule.detail: 5‑minute walk or stretch to reset posture.

schedule.title: Lunch & reset
schedule.detail: Balanced meal, avoid caffeine after this point.

schedule.title: Caffeine cutoff
schedule.detail: No more caffeine after this time to allow clearance before sleep.

schedule.title: Afternoon light & movement
schedule.detail: Brief outdoor walk or light activity.

schedule.title: Screen‑free study or review
schedule.detail: Use paper notes or low‑blue‑light tools.

schedule.title: Evening wind‑down start
schedule.detail: Dim lights, avoid screens, begin relaxing activities.

schedule.title: Digital sunset
schedule.detail: All screens off; use amber filters if needed.

priorities: Reduce daily screen time to under 6 h, especially after 19:00
